node/3732415309.quote: Colocation, Turnkey Data Center Portland OR | PTOR1 The Pittock Block is a historic landmark in downtown Portland that has evolved into a highly connected hub, crucial for companies requiring global access.
node/3732415309.reason: The node's operator=Alco Properties is out of date: Alco sold the Pittock Block in January 2021 to Harrison Street and a fund of fifteenfortyseven Critical Systems Realty (REBusiness, 2021-01-06), whose own site markets the building as its Portland data center PTOR1.

way/396296733.name: Csquare Lynnwood SEA3
way/396296733.quote: SEA3 Situated on Highway 99, our Lynwood data center has easy access to Interstate 5, connecting it to Seattle and the Everett area.
way/396296733.reason: Centersquare now trades as Csquare and calls this building SEA3: Csquare's Seattle spec sheet (2026) gives SEA3 at 17300 Highway 99, Lynnwood, the way's address, which OpenStreetMap still calls 'Centersquare Lynnwood SE1'.

way/439365340.quote: JLL is offering for lease or sale at 11751 Meadowville Lane in Chester, south of Richmond. The Virginia IT agency had been based there until it left last year.
way/439365340.reason: The way's name, 'Virginia Information Technologies Agency', names a tenant that left the building at 11751 Meadowville Lane in 2022 (Baxtel, 2023-05-15); no source names the data center now, so the record names none.

way/440666998.quote: 1928 East Deere St ( 1st Floor ) Verizon Enterprise
way/440666998.reason: Baxtel lists 1928 East Deere St, the way's address, as 'Verizon: Santa Ana', an operational facility of Verizon Enterprise; XO Communications, which the way's name gives, is not named there, so the record names no site.

way/460212563.quote: Cyxtera's BR1 site in Burbank was acquired via a $2.8 billion transaction to acquire 57 datacenters from CenturyLink.

way/903642490.quote: FamilySearch centers are found in many types of buildings, like churches or libraries. They are open to the public and offer access to exclusive records and complimentary access to technology.
